description: Check that a list of parts fits together (caliber, AR-15 vs AR-10, gas system, thread pitch, handguard mount) the way the GunPartPicker builder does, and price the total. Returns problems per part and one build_url that opens the whole build on GunPartPicker. Up to 20 parts, as slugs or product URLs.
name: check_build
title: Check a build fits
